subject: Request to move demo to provide time for prompt rehearsal and SSO/sample provisioning
messages:
From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira.k@brightlinehealth.com>, Ethan Lowe <ethan.l@brightlinehealth.com>
Cc: priyom.das@redwood.ai, marcus.lin@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Run-through buffer request before Wed demo

Hi Samira / Ethan —

Quick note: we have the product showcase scheduled for Wednesday (Jul 14) but two blockers popped up that will materially impact the quality of the demo if we proceed as-is:

1) Customer SSO provisioning is still pending (IdP metadata needed).
2) We don’t have a locked prompt set and need a final rehearsal with the workload traces you provided to exercise failover behavior.

Would you be open to moving the demo ~72 hours later so we can:
- finish SSO setup and validate a test account
- run a full prompt rehearsal on a representative trace
- stage the sample data and confirm data mapping in the demo tenant

If a hard move isn’t possible, we can keep Wed but we’ll convert it to a technical dry run and then do the executive showcase the following week. Either way, we want to avoid underwhelming your stakeholders.

Proposed alternate windows (PDT):
- Mon, Jul 19 10:00–11:00 or 14:00–15:00
- Tue, Jul 20 09:00–11:00

I’ve attached a short runbook and sample dataset stub. I’ll coordinate with Priyom on provisioning.

Thanks —
Chloe
Chloe Martin
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
(Attachment: runbook-demo-brief.pdf (PDF, 82 KB); sample_dataset.csv (CSV, 24 KB))

From: Samira Khan <samira.k@brightlinehealth.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ethan Lowe <ethan.l@brightlinehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2027 11:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Run-through buffer request before Wed demo

Thanks for the heads up, Chloe —

We definitely prefer a polished demo. A couple constraints on our side: Jul 19 is impossible because a leadership offsite is scheduled; Jul 20 morning looks promising but I need to confirm with Procurement whether they can join.

Can we target Tue, Jul 20 10:00–11:00 PT for the full showcase (execs + tech) if the SSO is done and you confirm the prompt rehearsal is completed? If you need additional access to our sample traces we can provision a temporary S3 share.

Also, small ask — if you move the customer-facing demo, can you keep Wed as a short internal dry-run for your team so your engineers can validate the KV/cache behaviour?

Appreciate the coordination —
Samira
Samira Khan
Director, Product Integration | Brightline Health
(Procurement alias: procurement@brightlinehealth.com)

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira.k@brightlinehealth.com>, Ethan Lowe <ethan.l@brightlinehealth.com>
Cc: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 13 Jul 2027 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Run-through buffer request before Wed demo

Hi Samira —

Thanks — Tue Jul 20 10:00–11:00 PT works on our side; we’ll keep Wed as an internal engineering dry run. To make the Tue showcase successful we need three quick items from Brightline:

1) IdP metadata for SSO (SAML metadata XML or Okta org URL). Please send to integrations@redwood.ai.
2) A representative workload trace (or the S3 share link you mentioned). Ideally the trace includes ~200 short sequences and at least one long conversation to exercise batching.
3) Confirmation of stakeholder list so we can tailor the exec slides (names + titles).

Action items we’ll complete before Tue 10:00 PT:
- Provision a test tenant and create one SSO test account (Marcus)
- Lock prompt set and perform two end-to-end rehearsals on the provided trace (Chloe + Dev team)
- Attach the final mutual action plan and a short checklist for the exec showcase.

I’ve attached an updated mutual action plan with the new dates and the runbook. Also dropping a short checklist below you can forward to Procurement so they know what to approve quickly.

---
Quick procurement checklist for demo access:
- Temp S3 share to sample_dataset.csv (read-only)
- Completed NDA/PO uplift for demo tenant (if required)
- List of attendees that need access to the test tenant
---

(Attachments: mutual-action-plan.xlsx (XLSX, 18 KB); runbook-demo-brief.pdf (PDF, 82 KB))

Sharing links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2B3Cexample
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/BRG-2937

Thanks —
Priyom
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference

From: Ethan Lowe <ethan.l@brightlinehealth.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samira Khan <samira.k@brightlinehealth.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Jul 2027 15:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Run-through buffer request before Wed demo

Confirmed — Tue Jul 20 10:00–11:00 PT works for leadership and Procurement has okayed the temporary S3 share. I’ll send the SSO metadata and the link to the trace by EOD Monday.

We’ll also join your Wed internal dry run at 09:00 PT if you’d like us to observe.

Ethan
Ethan Lowe
VP, Customer Solutions | Brightline Health
(Attachment: permissions_readme.txt (TXT, 1 KB))
